title: New York Robotics Consortium Launches with 160 Startups
content:
# 纽约机器人联盟携160家初创公司正式启动

该消息发布之际，纽约州正努力在全球机器人竞赛中确立其重要竞争者的地位。

![高科技机器人正在装配线上工作](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/bltf7d067fcf2fa6d68/6980e0582e80c25cbe04996f/robot.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)

旨在推动纽约大都会区机器人社区发展的非营利组织“纽约机器人”已正式启动。

该组织于上周启动，汇集了超过160家机器人初创公司，其目标是帮助巩固纽约在日益增长的机器人领域中的可行竞争者地位，以与波士顿、硅谷和慕尼黑等更成熟的中心竞争。全球精密齿轮和机械部件领导者SDP/SI也是其创始合作伙伴。

纽约机器人的启动恰逢其对AlleyCorp首届Deep Tech NY会议的赞助。纽约机器人表示，此举也将提升纽约州作为机器人创新和投资熔炉的地位。

纽约机器人成立于2024年，是一家非营利组织，旨在改善其认为长期存在的差距：尽管纽约具备成为机器人领导者的技术专长，但公司往往因组织孤岛而受阻。

通过创建一个共享的生态系统，纽约机器人表示希望消除这些障碍，并支持全州范围内的自动化应用。

作为创始合作伙伴，SDP/SI的角色将为初创公司提供所需的硬件、工程专业知识以及供应链可靠性，以帮助它们“从原型走向生产”。

纽约机器人执行董事Jacob Hennessey-Rubin在关于启动的[博客文章](https://nycrobotics.org/latest/news/new-york-robotics-formally-launches-amid-surge-in-robotics-investment-demand-and-talent)中表示：“我们的愿景是利用纽约在全球技术舞台上的中心地位，使其成为机器人创新的领先枢纽。通过快速扩展生态系统并将机器人提升为华尔街一个严肃的投资类别，我们正在为纽约在这个变革性领域确立长期领导地位。”

作为启动的一部分，纽约机器人还发布了NYR Index的私有测试版。这是一个专有平台，为合作伙伴提供对初创公司、投资者、实验室和企业参与者的数据、见解和地图的独家访问权限。

迄今为止，该组织还任命了几家创始成员，包括摩根大通、纽约大学、AlleyCorp、EisnerAmper和Cybernetix Ventures。

AlleyCorp的普通合伙人Abe Murray表示：“我们认为纽约对全球机器人社区至关重要，纽约机器人为加强该网络所做的工作对这座城市众多初创公司的未来增长和成功具有巨大影响。”

# New York Robotics Consortium Launches with 160 Startups
The news comes as the state works to place itself as a serious contender in the global robotics race.
[Scarlett Evans](https://aibusiness.com/author/scarlett-evans), Contributing Writer
February 2, 2026
2 Min Read
![High-tech robotics working on an assembly line ](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/bltf7d067fcf2fa6d68/6980e0582e80c25cbe04996f/robot.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)
adventtr via Getty Image
New York Robotics, a non-profit organization set up to advance the robotics community in the New York metropolitan area, has officially launched.
Opening last week with more than 160 robotics startups, the group pitches itself as helping cement New York as a viable contender in the growing robotics space, ramping up to compete with more established hubs such as Boston, Silicon Valley and Munich. SDP/SI, a global leader in precision gears and mechanical components, is also a founding partner.
NYR's launch coincides with a sponsorship of AlleyCorp's inaugural Deep Tech NY conference, which NYR said also advances the state's standing as a melting pot for robotics innovation and investment.
Established as a non-profit in 2024, NYR was set up to improve what it identified as a long-standing gap: While the technological know-how for New York to emerge as a robotics leader is there, companies are often held back by organizational silos.
Related: [OpenMind Unveils Robot App Store](https://aibusiness.com/robotics/openmind-unveils-robot-app-store)
By creating a shared ecosystem, NYR said it hopes to remove these barriers and support automation uptake across the state.
SDP/SI's role as a founding partner will provide startups with access to hardware, engineering expertise, and supply-chain reliability needed to "move from prototype to production."
"Our vision is to leverage New York's centrality on the global technology stage to become a leading hub for robotics innovation," Jacob Hennessey-Rubin, executive director of NYR, said in a [blog post](https://nycrobotics.org/latest/news/new-york-robotics-formally-launches-amid-surge-in-robotics-investment-demand-and-talent) on the launch. "By rapidly expanding the ecosystem and elevating robotics as a serious investment class on Wall Street, we're positioning New York for long-term leadership in this transformative sector."
As part of the launch, NYR also released a private-beta version of the NYR Index, a proprietary platform that provides partners with exclusive access to data, insights and mapping across startups, investors, labs and enterprise participants.
To date, the group has also named several founding members including J.P. Morgan, New York University, AlleyCorp, EisnerAmper and Cybernetix Ventures.
"We see New York as essential to the global robotics community, and the work New York Robotics is doing to strengthen that network is hugely impactful to the future growth and success of so many startups here in the city," said Abe Murray, general partner at AlleyCorp.

title: Apple Acquires Israeli Startup Q.AI
content:
# 苹果收购以色列初创公司 Q.AI

虽然财务细节未披露，但此次交易被描述为苹果公司“有史以来第二大收购案”。

![纽约市的苹果商店](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/blt5583a26f674e9a46/697cb368b7023a6556c8efe0/apple.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)

苹果公司似乎正在加码，通过收购以色列初创公司 Q.AI 来增强其在创造人工智能可穿戴设备领域的竞争力。

虽然具体数字尚未在此阶段得到证实——路透社称其价值 16 亿美元，而《金融时报》报道称该交易对 Q.AI 的估值接近 20 亿美元——但交易本身已获双方确认，均已向媒体发布声明。

该交易得到了风险投资公司 Matter Venture Partners、Kleiner Perkins、Spark Capital、Exor 和 GV（前身为 Google Ventures）的支持。后者在一篇博客文章中将其描述为“苹果公司有史以来第二大收购案”。

这使其规模仅次于 2014 年以 30 亿美元收购 Beats Music 和 Beats Electronics 的交易。

苹果公司花钱买到了什么尚不完全清楚。Q.AI 的网站除了这句宽泛的声明外，几乎没有提供任何线索：“在一个充满噪音的世界里，我们创造了一种新的宁静。”

这引发了人们对未来可能发生什么的猜测。无论计划如何，这笔交易似乎旨在增强苹果的可穿戴设备产品组合，而 Meta 等公司已凭借其智能眼镜在该领域取得了进展。

投资者 GV 指出：“苹果一直是‘隐形界面’的大师——那种感觉像是自我延伸的技术。”并补充说，Q.AI 的工作有潜力从根本上改变我们彼此连接的方式。

回顾这笔交易，Q.AI 首席执行官 Aviad Maizels 在一份声明中表示：“加入苹果为突破界限、实现我们所创造技术的全部潜力开辟了非凡的可能性，我们很高兴能将这种体验带给世界各地的人们。”

苹果公司硬件技术高级副总裁 Johny Srouji 将 Q.AI 描述为“一家卓越的公司，正在开创使用成像和机器学习的新颖创造性方式。”他补充道：“我们很高兴能收购这家公司，并由 Aviad 掌舵，并对未来的发展更加期待。”

# Apple Acquires Israeli Startup Q.AI
While financial details were not disclosed, the deal is being characterized as Apple's "second largest acquisition in history."
[Graham Hope](https://aibusiness.com/author/graham-hope), Contributing Writer
January 30, 2026
![Apple store in New York City](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/blt5583a26f674e9a46/697cb368b7023a6556c8efe0/apple.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)
ozgurdonmaz via Getty Images
Apple appears to be upping the ante in the battle to create AI-powered wearables with a deal to acquire Israeli startup Q.AI.
While the exact figures have not been verified at this stage — Reuters suggested it was worth $1.6 billion while the [Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/content/49f4e2e4-3a68-4842-be67-879409d06aa1) reported that the transaction valued Q.AI at nearly $2 billion — the deal itself has, with both parties confirming it via statements issued to the press.
The deal was backed by venture capital firms Matter Venture Partners, Kleiner Perkins, Spark Capital, Exor and GV, formerly Google Ventures, with the latter describing it as "Apple's second largest acquisition in its history" [in a blog](https://www.gv.com/news/q-ai-joins-apple) post.
That places it behind only the purchase of [Beats Music and Beats Electronics](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2014/05/28Apple-to-Acquire-Beats-Music-Beats-Electronics/) for $3 billion in 2014.
What Apple is getting for its money isn't entirely clear. [Q.AI's website](https://www.q.ai/) provides few clues beyond this broad statement: "In a world full of noise we craft a new kind of quiet."
Related: [AMD Competes With Intel With New AI Chips](https://aibusiness.com/consumer-tech/amd-competes-with-intel-with-new-ai-chips)
This has led to speculation as to what might be in store. Whatever is planned, it seems that the deal is aimed at bolstering Apple's wearables portfolio, where the likes of Meta has forged ahead [with its smart glasses](https://aibusiness.com/nlp/meta-ray-ban-smart-glasses-get-ai-boost).
Investor GV pointed out: "Apple has always been the master of the 'invisible interface' — the technology that feels like an extension of yourself," and added that Q.AI's work had the potential to fundamentally change how we connect with each other.
Reflecting on the deal, Q.AI CEO Aviad Maizels said in a statement: "Joining Apple opens extraordinary possibilities for pushing boundaries and realizing the full potential of what we've created, and we're thrilled to bring these experiences to people everywhere."
Johny Srouji, Apple's senior vice president of hardware technologies, described Q.AI as "a remarkable company that is pioneering new and creative ways to use imaging and machine learning." He added: "We're thrilled to acquire the company, with Aviad at the helm, and are even more excited for what's to come."
Related: [HP's New Keyboard Gives New Meaning to All-in-One](https://aibusiness.com/consumer-tech/hp-s-new-keyboard-gives-new-meaning-to-all-in-one)

title: Google DeepMind Introduces Agentic Vision to Gemini 3 Flash
content:
# Google DeepMind 为 Gemini 3 Flash 引入代理视觉功能

新功能将视觉推理与 Python 代码相结合，以改进图像分析并实现主动调查。

![位于英国伦敦的 Google DeepMind 办公室](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/bltb05e3cce6a80ec32/697be1d456130b4cb37e3ad9/deepmind.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)

Google DeepMind 本周为其 Gemini 3 Flash 模型添加了代理视觉功能，将图像分析从被动任务转变为主动任务。

虽然典型的多模态模型通过单次“扫视”处理图像，但通过引入代理功能，Google 使其模型能够主动研究图片并聚焦于特定细节，例如路标或微芯片上的序列号。

这项新功能通过生成并运行 Python 代码来工作，该代码可以系统地放大、处理和检查图像。

Google DeepMind 的产品经理 Rohan Doshi 在一篇关于此公告的[博客文章](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/agentic-vision-gemini-3-flash/)中写道：“通过将视觉推理与代码执行（代理视觉支持的首批工具之一）相结合，模型可以制定计划，逐步放大、检查和操作图像，将答案建立在视觉证据之上。”

该功能使用“思考-行动-观察”循环，即 Gemini 3 Flash 将研究用户查询和图像并制定计划，使用 Python 代码主动进行图像分析，然后在生成最终响应之前检查结果。

根据 Google 的说法，此次更新在视觉基准测试中实现了 5% 到 10% 的质量提升。

Google 表示，通过 Google AI Studio，此次更新已经展示了一系列新的代理行为，例如迭代缩放、直接图像标注和视觉绘图。据说后者可以减少幻觉——这是视觉数学任务中的一个常见问题。

展望未来，该公司表示计划向模型中添加更多隐式的代码驱动行为，这意味着目前需要特定提示的某些功能将变为自主功能。

# Google DeepMind Introduces Agentic Vision to Gemini 3 Flash
The new capabilities combine visual reasoning with Python code to improve image analysis and enable active investigations.
[Scarlett Evans](https://aibusiness.com/author/scarlett-evans), Contributing Writer
January 29, 2026
![ Google DeepMind offices in London, England](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/bltb05e3cce6a80ec32/697be1d456130b4cb37e3ad9/deepmind.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)
Dan Kitwood/Staff via Getty Images
Google DeepMind added this week agentic vision capabilities to its Gemini 3 Flash model, turning image analysis an active rather than passive task.
While typical multimodal models process images in a single "glance," by introducing agentic capabilities, Google allows its model to actively study a picture and home in on specific details, such as street signs or a serial number on a microchip.
The new feature works by generating and running Python code that zooms, manipulates and inspects images methodically.
"By combining visual reasoning with code execution, one of the first tools supported by Agentic Vision, the model formulates plans to zoom in, inspect and manipulate images step-by-step, grounding answers in visual evidence," Rohan Doshi, product manager at Google DeepMind, wrote in a [blog post](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/agentic-vision-gemini-3-flash/) about the announcement.
The feature uses a Think-Act-Observe loop, whereby Gemini 3 Flash will study a user query and image and formulate a plan, use Python code to actively conduct an image analysis, and then inspect the results before generating its final response.
According to Google, the update saw a quality improvement of between 5% to 10% across vision benchmarks.
A range of new agentic behaviors have, Google said, already been demonstrated from the update via Google AI Studio, such as iterative zooming, direct image annotation and visual plotting. The latter is said to reduce hallucinations ­— a common problem with visual math tasks.
Looking ahead, the company said it plans to add more implicit code-driven behaviors into the model, meaning certain capabilities that currently require a specific prompt will become an autonomous feature.
